title: SAFER-INSTRUCT: Aligning Language Models with Automated Preference Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of automatically generating safety preference data to align Large Language Models with human preferences (RLHF/DPO). While it addresses safety categories such as hate speech and discrimination (which intersect with ethics), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religious traditions, theology, or specific philosophical moral frameworks as a primary component of the work.
